title: Rldcoin: Interstellar Peer-to-Peer Payments
authorization_scope: Owner explicitly requested a new whitepaper targeting Interstellar Peer-to-Peer Payments, disregarding all content and architectural constraints of the existing paper. The new research architecture is authored within that clean-slate scope; the previously authorized website synchronization follows its content.
architecture: Single-home spend authority; final local settlement under accepted Byzantine validator assumptions; destination-bound source exports; permanent import-or-reject decisions; rejection-evidence-dependent source recovery; monotonic monetary provenance.

research_supersession.note: Deliberate changes to the proposed research design, not changes to existing signed currencies, implementation profiles or historical obligations.

claims: Conditional transition-level arguments for unique destination decisions, import/recovery exclusion, conservation over causal executions, local finality across inter-domain disconnection and conditional progress. No claimed invention of BFT, certified transfer or a new cryptographic primitive; no exhaustive novelty or priority claim.
assumptions: Accepted initial domain and asset anchors; at most f Byzantine among 3f+1 validators in each relevant configuration, including applicable later historical-key compromise; correct commit/locking and handoff protocols; secure cryptography; owner authorization; durable output/export/decision state. Progress additionally needs responsive local quorums, complete evidence, accepted policies, funded resources and usable contact paths.
limitations: Threshold compromise, stranded in-flight value, quorum unavailability, provenance-dependent fungibility, historical key compromise, archive growth, governance and physical delivery remain explicit. No achieved throughput, implemented complete protocol, independent audit, machine-checked proof, universal permissionless consensus or world-changing outcome is certified.
implementation_boundary: No protocol/node source, live network, asset balance, monetary genesis, signing keys or adoption policy is changed. Prior receipts, failures, source-bound evidence and existing implementation obligations retain their original scope. A future implementation requires an exact separately identified profile and explicit reconciliation; no test value or keys migrate.
